content.title: 2026 Players Championship: How to watch the golf tournament today, Round 3 tee times, TV channel, streaming schedule and more
content.text: The 52nd edition of the Players Championship begins this week with some of the top golfers on the PGA Tour, including past champions Rory McIlroy, Scottie Scheffler, Adam Scott and Si Woo Kim competing at TPC Sawgrass in Florida. There are also fourteen golfers making their tournament debut this year, among them are Michael Brennan, Steven Fisk and William Mouw. The tournament runs from Thursday until Sunday, and you can keep tabs on the leaderboard here.To watch all the action at this week's Players Championship, you can catch daily live streaming coverage on ESPN+. On Thursday and Friday, Golf Channel will broadcast live coverage, and on Saturday and Sunday, broadcast coverage will air on NBC and stream on Peacock. Here's what you need to know about the complete golf tournament schedule, streaming info, and Rounds 1 and 2 tee times.AdvertisementDates: March 12-15TV channel: NBC, Golf ChannelStreaming: ESPN+, Peacock, DirecTV, Hulu + Live TVWhen is the 2026 Players Championship?The 2026 Players Championship runs from March 12-15, 2026.What channel is the 2026 Players Championship on?On Thursday and Friday, you can tune in to the Players Championship on Golf Channel, and weekend coverage will air on NBC.How to stream the Players Championship without cable:For the most comprehensive live coverage of every round, you'll need to tune into ESPN+. ESPN+ will stream daily coverage of the tournament and is available as part of either an ESPN Select or ESPN Unlimited plan.AdvertisementTo watch the Golf Channel and NBC, those channels are available with subscriptions to DirecTV and Hulu + Live TV, and NBC coverage will also stream on Peacock.ESPN's new streaming service is divided into two tiers: ESPN Unlimited and ESPN Select. For $29.99, the ESPN Unlimited package includes access to all of ESPN's linear networks: ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, SECN, ACCN, ESPNews, and ESPN Deportes, as well as access to programming on ABC, ESPN+, ESPN3, SECN+, and ACCNX. That means fans will get coverage of more than 47,000 live events each year, plus on-demand replays, original programming, and more. ESPN Select (also known as the original ESPN+) is still an option if you don't want to commit to the full package. For $12.99/month, you can tune in and get exclusive access to pro and college sports and more. You can watch the Players Championship with a subscription to either ESPN Unlimited or ESPN Select. For $11/month, an ad-supported Peacock Premium subscription lets you stream live sports and events airing on NBC, including the 2026 Players Championship. Plus, you'll get access to thousands of hours of shows and movies, including beloved sitcoms such as Parks and Recreation and The Office, every Bravo show and much more. For $17/month, you can upgrade to an ad-free Premium Plus subscription, which includes live access to your local NBC affiliate (not just during designated sports and events) and the ability to download select titles to watch offline. 2026 Players Championship broadcast schedule:All times EasternSaturday, March 142-7 p.m. (NBC, Peacock), 8 a.m.-7 p.m. (ESPN+)Sunday, March 151-6 p.m. (NBC/Peacock), 7:30 a.m. - 6 p.m. (ESPN+)2026 Players Championship Round 3 Tee Times:All times ETTee No. 18:15 a.m. – Seamus Power8:20 a.m. – Patrick Cantlay, Michael Brennan8:30 a.m. – Danny Walker, Kristoffer Reitan8:40 a.m. – Rico Hoey, Daniel Berger8:50 a.m. – Zach Bauchou,9:00 a.m. – Stephan Jaeger, Steven FiskAdvertisement9:10 a.m. – J.T.
